munit:test.name: get-error-type-as-string
munit:test.description: getErrorTypeAsString formats namespace:identifier and falls back to UNKNOWN when the namespace is blank.

munit-tools:assert-equals.actual: #[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- getErrorTypeAsString({namespace: 'HTTP', identifier: 'NOT_FOUND'})]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- getErrorTypeAsString({namespace: '', identifier: 'NOT_FOUND'})]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- getErrorTypeAsString(null)]

munit:test.name: get-error-lookup-precedence
munit:test.description: getError resolves exact matches first, then *:IDENTIFIER, then NAMESPACE:*, then UNKNOWN; custom errors override defaults.

munit-tools:assert-equals.actual: #[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- getError('HTTP:NOT_FOUND', vars.errorList).message]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- getError('SOCKETS:TIMEOUT', vars.errorList).message]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- getError('HTTP:TOO_MANY_REQUESTS', vars.errorList).message]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- getError('DB:CONNECTIVITY', vars.errorList).message]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- getError('HTTP:NOT_FOUND', vars.errorList, {'HTTP:NOT_FOUND': { code: 404, reason: 'Not Found', message: 'custom' }}).message]

munit:test.name: to-string-handles-all-types
munit:test.description: toString converts Strings, Numbers, Binary, and complex values; empty input returns the provided default.

munit-tools:assert-equals.actual: #[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- toString('plain')]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- toString(42)]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- toString('binary content' as Binary)]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- toString(null, 'fallback')]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- toString('', 'fallback')]

munit:test.name: is-empty-value-never-fails
munit:test.description: isEmptyValue behaves like isEmpty but does not fail on types isEmpty does not support, like Binary.

munit-tools:assert-equals.actual: #[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- isEmptyValue(null)]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- isEmptyValue('')]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- isEmptyValue({})]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- isEmptyValue('content' as Binary)]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- isEmptyValue('' as Binary)]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- isEmptyValue(42)]

munit:test.name: find-error-mapping-returns-null-when-unmatched
munit:test.description: findErrorMapping resolves with the same precedence as getError (exact, *:IDENTIFIER, NAMESPACE:*) but returns null instead of the UNKNOWN fallback.

munit-tools:assert-equals.actual: #[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- findErrorMapping('HTTP:NOT_FOUND', vars.errorList).message]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- findErrorMapping('SOCKETS:TIMEOUT', vars.errorList).message]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- findErrorMapping('HTTP:TOO_MANY_REQUESTS', vars.errorList).message]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- findErrorMapping('DB:CONNECTIVITY', vars.errorList)]

munit:test.name: resolve-nested-error-mapping-rules
munit:test.description: resolveNestedErrorMapping (wayfinder ticket 003): unwraps known wrapper types and UNKNOWN-with-nested-errors to the leaf standard errors across childErrors/suppressedErrors, recursing and deduplicating; the highest status code wins, ties keep the first occurrence; returns null when nothing resolves or unwrapping does not apply.

munit:test.name: resolve-status-code-passthrough-rules
munit:test.description: resolveStatusCodePassthrough (wayfinder ticket 014): unmapped error types with a readable downstream statusCode resolve to that status and reason phrase, keeping the UNKNOWN entry's message; explicit mappings (including custom MULE:UNKNOWN) and missing/non-numeric status codes return null.

munit-tools:assert-equals.actual: #[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- resolveStatusCodePassthrough(vars.unknown422, vars.errorList).code]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- resolveStatusCodePassthrough(vars.unknown422, vars.errorList).reason]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- resolveStatusCodePassthrough(vars.unknown422, vars.errorList).message]

munit:test.name: get-previous-error-message-edge-cases
munit:test.description: getPreviousErrorMessage extracts childErrors/suppressedErrors/standard payloads, deduplicates messages, converts Binary and plain text safely, and returns an empty String when there is no nested error.

munit-tools:assert-equals.actual: #[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- getPreviousErrorMessage({ childErrors: [], suppressedErrors: [], errorMessage: null })]
#[%dw 2.0 import * from module_error_handler_plugin::common --- getPreviousErrorMessage(null)]
